def law(x):
    return x*x + 1 if x < 7 else 0
rationale: Measured all 10 declared candidates once. Inputs 0–6 yield 1, 2, 5, 10, 17, 26, 37; inputs 7–9 yield 0. The law matches every candidate exactly. Corrected measurements would change the answer; an expanded domain would require further validation.
